scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @doan/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.callcenter:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile callcenter up -d --build asterisk
scripts.callcenter:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile callcenter logs -f asterisk
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @doan/shared && npm run build --workspace @doan/api && npm run build --workspace @doan/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @doan/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @doan/shared && npm run build --workspace @doan/api && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lab: npm run build --workspace @doan/shared && npm run build --workspace @doan/api && node experiments/media-lab/harness.mjs
